descriptions.w3d_d29g_sky_start_8004f564: Sky start: stores the service for one name at +68, registers two more services for the object id, starts the geyser particle at (0, 0, -10), binds a global with the sound service, then loads a 3 by 3 checkerboard of sprites into the grid at +28 from the Shotgun and Uzi resources, placing each at 130-unit spacing centred on the origin and sized 4.6.
